title: final functor
why_consulted: vol1 ch08 §4.1、§5.1、§6.2 查过来：共尾性（cofinality）是「把余极限沿指标范畴替换」的全部技术依据，DAG 用 cofinal 一词，需与 nLab 的 final functor 对齐并确认（可缩纤维 ⇒ 共尾）这一判据
definition_zh: 函子 F:C→D 称为共尾的（final，旧称 cofinal），是指沿 F 限制图表不改变其余极限：对每个 D-图表，其 colim 与沿 F 拉回所得的 C-图表 colim 典范同构。对偶地，若沿 F 拉回不改变极限则称 F 为初始（initial）函子。注意该性质与 F 在函子范畴 [C,D] 中是否为始/终端对象基本无关；术语来自「对象 d∈D 是始（终）对象当且仅当对应的函子 d:1→D 是始（终）函子」。nLab 特别提示：HTT 等文献把 final 函子称作 cofinal，DAG 沿用 cofinal 一名，本译本按 TERMINOLOGY 统一作「共尾」。DAG 第 8 章反复用两条判据：(i) 余笛卡尔纤维化若纤维皆可缩则共尾（§4.1.1、§5.1.1）；(ii) 函子若有左伴随则共尾（§6.2.2 的「上述函子有左伴随」即是此用）。
key_points: final（共尾）：沿 F 限制不改变 colim；对偶的 initial（初始）：沿 F 限制不改变 lim
术语警示：HTT 等旧文献把 final 叫 cofinal，「co-」在此并不表示对偶，勿与余极限方向混淆
判据一：余笛卡尔纤维化的纤维若都可缩，则全函子共尾（DAG §4.1.1、§5.1.1 用它把余极限换成纤维上的余极限）
判据二：函子有左伴随则共尾（§6.2.2 用它把 (C_horiz)_{/d} 与 Corr(C) 的指标范畴对齐）
DAG 第 8 章的所有「共尾」替换最终都服务于把 LKE 的余极限计算化归为 §3.1 已算出的那一串 Ψ(β)∘Ψ^!(α)
idea_original: A functor F:C→DF \colon C \to D is final, if restricting diagrams along FF does not change their colimit. Dually, a functor is initial if pulling back diagrams along it does not change the limits of these diagrams. Beware that this property is pretty much unrelated to that of a functor being an initial object or terminal object in the functor category [C,D][C,D]. The terminology comes instead from the fact that an object d∈Dd\in D is initial (resp. terminal) just when the corresponding functor d:1→Dd \colon 1\to D is initial (resp. final). Remark (warning on terminology) In older references (and also some others like HTT), final functors are sometimes called cofinal, the terminology having been imported from order theory (cf. cofinality). However, this is confusing in category theory because usually the prefix “co-” denotes dualization. In at least one place (Borceux) this non-dualization was treated as a dualization and the word “final” used for the dual concept, but in general it seems that the consensus is to use “final” for what used to be called “cofinal”, and “initial” for the dual concept (since “co-final” would be ambiguous). For example, Johnstone in Sketches of an Elephan
references: Saunders Mac Lane, Section IX.3 of: Categories for the Working Mathematician

Paolo Perrone, Walter Tholen, Kan extensions are partial colimits, Applied Categorical Structures, 2022. (arXiv:2101.04531) (this says “confinal functor” for the version under which colimits are invariant)
our_term: 共尾（cofinal / final）；TERMINOLOGY.md 作「共尾」，「共尾函子」为全称
